title: Otori Emu — A Momentary Reunion〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hum humhuumhum♪ Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Maid
rows.Line:
Ms. Emu, would you like another cup of tea?
There are many cookies left as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really? Then, seconds☆

rows.Speaker: Maid
rows.Line:
Understood.
Oh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Dad! Welcome home!
Are you already done with work for today?

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: No... My meal with our overseas partners has simply been postponed.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: I found a Chinese restaurant and wanted to have lunch there, but my secretary here put a stop to that.

rows.Speaker: Secretary
rows.Line:
My apologies, sir.
That presented some security concerns.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gotcha! So then you came back home!

rows.Speaker: Maid
rows.Line: In that case, I will arrange for your meal. It will be ready shortly.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, wanna have some cookies while you wait? They're our snack for today♪

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: Thank you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: Hm? That notebook...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This? Hehehe, it's my idea notebook☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I write down all the stuff I think would be fun to do at Phoenix Wonderland and stuff that'd be good to have♪

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: I see. You've been thinking about these things quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: Sorry to ask, but could you fetch that notebook from my study? My father's.

rows.Speaker: Secretary
rows.Line: Of course, right away.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What notebook?

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: It belonged to your grandfather.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: Like you, Emu, he wrote quite a few ideas down.

rows.Speaker: Secretary
rows.Line: Apologies for the wait.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: Yes, this is the one. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: Emu, you can have this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? But this belonged to Grandpa. It must mean a lot to you, right...?

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: It does. And because it has such meaning, I think you should hold on to it.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: There are plenty more where that came from. His other notebooks should be set aside in our archive, so I'll have it arranged that they be made available to you as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: That notebook contains renovation ideas for the family lodge that was built back in his day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A lodge...?

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: You were two or three years old when we took you there. It's no surprise you don't remember.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: It wasn't originally designed with children in mind, so we had plans to renovate the place based on his ideas and make it more enjoyable for you and your siblings.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: No, never mind that.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: My father wasn't able to make those ideas a reality himself, but I'm sure he'll be happy to know that someone has taken up the torch in one sense or another.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: Treat that with care. Both the notebook, and your grandfather's wishes...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Right! I'll take super good care of them!
Thanks, Dad!
Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He gave me something really great!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wonder what kinds of ideas are in here...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa! He wrote a lot, and drew a lot too!
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Rock climbing wall. Leads up to second floor.”
“It's getting kinda hard for ol' gramps, so make some less steep stairs.”
“Make the steps short for the kids too?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Being able to climb the wall up to the second floor sounds so fun...! And he's thinking about how to make the stairs easy to climb too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What else... “Replace the floor or walls with glass to make an aquarium with plenty of fish.” “A bathroom that makes you think you're underwater”...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooow! Having any of this stuff in your house would make every day so fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, but there's an asterisk by the aquarium idea...
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Making an aquarium would require major changes to the building itself. Considering all the memories this lodge holds, perhaps renovations should be kept to a minimum”...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He's got so many notes about what would be needed and what to be careful of...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Grandpa really was amazing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I talked to him lots about shows, and we got to chat about this and that all the time, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wish I could've asked him lots about his work too...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't get to talk to him anymore, but he's left this notebook behind!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alrighty! I'm gonna read every line and study up♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? My phone just...
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? I'm in SEKAI all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Why's it all dark?
It was still snack time back home...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! Something's flashing over there!
Could it be a star?!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Fooound ya☆
So this round ball thing here is where the light's coming from!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is this a prop for a show? I'm gonna go show everybody♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wah! What's going on? It's so bright!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Well that threw me for a loop!
I didn't think it'd go all flashy-flash like that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, huh what?!
Now I'm not in SEKAI, I'm in somebody's house?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I...think I recognize this place...
Ah, Emu. Thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hwah?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: G-GGGGGGGGG...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: GRANDPA?!
